title: Eagles' Peak
start: Talk to Charlie the Zookeeper in Ardougne Zoo.

recommended.t: Teleportation runes to Ardougne and Varrock, Ardougne cloak 1 or better (requires easy Ardougne achievements), alternatively activated Ardougne and Varrock lodestone.
Memory strands in the currency pouch to teleport just north campsite.
Dramen staff or Lunar staff with the ability to use fairy rings (Not required if A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift has been completed).
Energy potions or Explorer's ring or Spirit terrorbird with Tireless Run scrolls. (highly recommended)
The Book of Char can be useful as you can teleport right outside the mountain where the quest plays out once a day (requires The Firemaker's Curse).

rewards.t: Ability to capture ferrets using box traps
Ability to use ferrets to hunt multiple rabbits
Access to the Eagle transport system
The eagle costume (eagle cape and fake beak) used during the quest
A ferret is put in the Ardougne Zoo

steps.t: Talk to Charlie in Ardougne Zoo. [Chat: 1 Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing! › Accept]
Head to Eagles' Peak west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

sub.t: If Eagles' Peak lodestone is activated, teleport to it and run northwest.
Alternatively, teleport to the Memorial of Guthix using memory strands in the currency pouch and run southeast.

steps.t: Go to the northern side of the mountain's base to a campsite.
Inspect the books for a Bird book.
Read the book to obtain a Metal feather.
Climb the rocks attached to the mountain next to the campsite (25 Agility needed).
Use the metal feather on the rocky outcrop.
Enter the cave, then head south until a cutscene with Nickolaus plays.
Shout-to Nickolaus. [Chat: 1 The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you. › 2 So it's not that you're trapped then? › 1 Could I help at all?]
Pick up 10 eagle feathers in the dungeon (called "giant feathers" on the floor).
Head to the south-east corner of Varrock to the Fancy Clothes Store.
Talk to the Fancy-Dress shop owner. [Chat: 2 Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.]
Have the owner make you two eagle capes and two fake beaks. [Chat: 2 I've got the feathers and the materials you requested. › 1 Okay, here are the materials. Eagle me up.]
Equip your disguise (eagle cape and fake beak) and go back to the Eagle's Peak cave.
Go to the intersection by the entrance of the dungeon and follow the east path.
Go through the tunnel entrance.
Exit the tunnel (next to the birdseed holder)
Enter the middle tunnel to the west. (South of the entrance you originally used to enter the cave)
Inspect the stone pedestal and complete the trail by inspecting the first pile of rocks to the east, then north-east.
Inspect the opening in the wall to the north and kill the kebbit.
Take the silver feather dropped by the kebbit.
Exit this tunnel back into the main cave.
Go to the south-west corner of the main cave and enter through the entrance.
Try to grab the feather from the pedestal.
Operate each winch in the 4 corners of the room in any order.
Grab the bronze feather from the pedestal.
Leave the tunnel into the main cave.
Back in the main cave, head directly east to a stone door with an eagle carved in it.
Use each feather on the door.

sub.t: Use the golden feather on the door
Use the silver feather on the door
Use the bronze feather on the door

steps.t: Open the stone door
While wearing the disguise, click the eagle to Walk-past the giant eagle directly north
Talk to Nickolaus.
Head back to the campsite by teleporting to Eagles' Peak lodestone and running northwest, or alternatively:

sub.t: Exit the main cave back to eagles peak

p: In disguise walk past Eagle after right clicking on it and choosing the walk-past Eagle option
The door with all three feathers in it

steps.t: Talk to Nickolaus. [Chat: 1 Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret. › 1 That sounds good to me.]
Watch the cutscene.
Take the ferret back to Charlie in the Ardougne Zoo.
p: Catching the ferret for the zoo.

steps.t: Quest complete!
